palette.notes: NOT PIXEL ART (Hama bead craft tutorial, live footage). Code's 19 colours measure the room photo. The bead mural uses flat saturated anime colours: blues, orange, pink, white skull.

lighting: Warm daylight in a hobby room; side sun patch on the table near the end.
silhouette: A long vertical bead mural of stacked One Piece faces ending in the straw-hat skull; reads as a totem from above.

motion.timing: Code (first 20 s): median hold 33.3 ms, 27.23 changes/s: live 30 fps footage, sped-up process steps.

texture: Real fused beads with masking tape and ironing paper; bilingual caption text (Spanish + English) per step.
camera: Wide high angle from the end of the table, jump cuts between steps; maker leans in and out of frame.

acting.enters: Maker stands behind the mural at the start.
acting.acts: Tapes, cuts, flips the boards, removes pegboards, refills missing beads, brushes clean.
acting.depth: Mural dominates the foreground; maker works across it from behind.

techniques: one caption per step, two languages
mural covered then revealed again (tape on, boards off) for a second payoff
fixed wide angle so progress reads between jump cuts
feel: NOT PIXEL ART: bead craft tutorial; fixed wide shot + step captions + covered-then-revealed mural = satisfying process
for_fred: Hide and re-reveal the product: cover the result, let Fred do a few quick steps on captions, then pull the cover off for a second payoff.
